feats.title: Comeback
feats.description: If you are reduced to 0 hit points or fewer and return to consciousness in the same encounter, you gain a +1 bonus to AC and attack rolls until the end of the encounter.

feats.title: Dodge Giants
feats.description: You gain a +1 feat bonus to all defenses against the attacks of Large or larger foes. Whenever a Large or larger creature misses you with a melee attack, you can shift 1 square as a free action. The distance you can shift as a free action increases to 2 at 21st level.

feats.title: Knock Back
feats.description: When you succeed on a saving throw to avoid being knocked prone, you can knock prone one enemy of size Large or smaller that is adjacent to you.

feats.title: Quick Steps
feats.description: You gain a +1 feat bonus to speed.

feats.title: Fearsome Toughness
feats.description: When you use Dwarven Resilience, each enemy adjacent to you is marked by you until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Shield The Fallen
feats.description: When you are adjacent to a bloodied, unconscious, or helpless ally, that ally gains a +2 bonus to saving throws and all defenses. The benefit of this feat doesn't stack if more than one character with Shield the Fallen is adjacent to the same ally.

feats.title: Solid Footing
feats.description: You ignore difficult terrain that is the result of rubble, uneven stone, or earthen construction such as stairs.

feats.title: Bones of Stone
feats.description: Whenever you take a critical hit, roll a d20. If you roll an 11 or higher, the critical hit turns into a normal hit.
